description.value: You can use the force from your ranged weapon to give yourself some distance through the sheer force it emits. You make a ranged Strike at a creature up to 10 feet away from you. As you attack, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} directly away from your target with a +10 foot status bonus to your Leap. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and you make a successful Strike, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as part of this action. You do not increase your multi-attack penalty until after the Escape attempt.
